description: Climate and sustainability companies that closed a funding round in the last N days (up to 90), newest first. Each raise has company, amount, currency, amount_usd, round, round_date, detected_date, sectors, countries, investors, source_url (the primary source; null when only a feed is known) and raiselens_url. Also returns totals by sector, country and round. By default only checked company rounds: no funder pages or fund news, no off-sector rows, a source article that names the company, and a round date within 60 days. Each raise also carries hiring (open roles, roles in business development and partnerships, and the careers page) when the company has open roles on file. Optional filters: Raise Lens sector slug, country (ISO-2 or aggregate such as EU, AFRICA, GLOBAL), hiring_only.

checked_only.description: false also returns deals that fail the checks (no article URL naming the company, off-sector, fund news, round older than 60 days).

country.description: ISO-2 code or aggregate (EU, AFRICA, ASIA, LATAM, GLOBAL).

date_basis.description: announced: round date when the source gives one; detected: when Raise Lens picked it up.

deals_only.description: false also returns funder-page context the classifier filed as investment (programmes, portfolio pages).

hiring_only.description: true returns only companies that raised and are now hiring (open roles on file).

sector.description: One Raise Lens sector slug, such as renewable-energy.

name: list_recent_raises

bd_roles.description: Open roles in business development, partnerships or fundraising.

careers_url.description: The employer's own careers page or job board.

hiring.description: Raised and now hiring: open roles read from the company's own job board; null when none are on file.

kind.description: deal, or context for funder-page items.

source_url.description: The primary source; null when only a feed is known.

now_hiring.description: Raises whose company has open roles on file.

title: List recent funding rounds
